checks.evidence: tasks.md T-001/T-002/T-006 classify bounded inventory, contract, and conformance work medium; T-003/T-004/T-005 classify resolver trust, compatibility, and consent boundaries high with concrete rationales. No critical surface is introduced.

T-003 and T-005 require before-change RED, after-change GREEN, implementation-report evidence, and independent reviewer verdicts. T-004's explicitly human-approved, T-004-only amended Done When requires verified-version comparison, actual-usage compatibility regressions, independent evaluation, successful required CI on latest head, and regression coverage for discovered defects. This review applies that narrow amendment only; other task conditions and global gate requirements remain authoritative. This is plan review, not implementation or gate acceptance.

Six tasks divide the bounded tranche into inventory, ownership, resolver, compatibility, consent/provider boundary, and final evidence/host conformance. Each task has a focused boundary and inspectable completion criteria.

T-003 covers five target fixtures and required/optional/not-applicable/unavailable/not-run/unknown outcomes. T-004 covers absent, valid, stale, malformed context and legacy/hybrid preservation. T-005 and TEST-008/009 cover live consent changes, transient decline, standing audit deduplication, off, unknown/missing settings, unavailable provider, and no-upload fallback.

acceptance-tests.md assigns static inventory/review to consumer classification, contract/schema tests to ownership and vocabulary, unit/integration tests to evaluator behavior, actual-consumer regression and compatibility tests to legacy/hybrid paths, negative integration assertions to consent, and cross-host integration to adapter conformance.

T-003 retains the legacy context-presence fallback and reverts additive resolver changes; T-004 restores the pre-change reader/writer contract while retaining baseline fixtures; T-005 disables additive provider selection and restores local manual fallback. All high-risk tasks name bounded rollback actions.

T-001 inventories consumers; T-002 validates ownership; T-003 implements selection/evaluation; T-004 protects compatibility; T-005 isolates optional UI operations; T-006 normalizes evidence and verifies host semantics. T-006's release evidence roll-up does not replace earlier boundary implementation or tests.

The explicit serial T-001 through T-006 blocker chain and one-task-at-a-time constraint order shared-contract and consumer changes. Compatibility follows resolver work, consent follows compatibility, and final conformance follows provider-boundary work.
No task is designated a bugfix or debugging task. T-004 additionally requires fixing any discovered defect and retaining its regression coverage.
